summary: Russia conducted a massive overnight aerial campaign across multiple Ukrainian oblasts involving ballistic missiles, KAB guided bombs, and jet-powered Shahed drones, striking residential areas and logistics facilities despite a reportedly agreed three-day ceasefire window for US diplomatic visits. US envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in the Kremlin to discuss a peace plan while also planning a visit to Kyiv. Ukrainian General Staff confirmed combat operations continue in full because the ceasefire cannot be unilateral, directly contradicting Moscow's claims of reduced attacks.
key_points: Russia launched 4 ballistic missiles at Dnipro and Kamyanske, with additional missiles and jet Shaheds targeting Kyiv, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, and multiple other oblasts overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73743)

US envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in the Kremlin to discuss a peace plan, with Witkoff thanking Putin for halting strikes on Kyiv for three days to facilitate negotiations. (Source: @tass_agency/393961)

Ukrainian General Staff stated combat operations continue at full scale along the front line despite reports of a three-day 'silence regime,' asserting a ceasefire cannot be unilateral or asymmetric. (Source: @UkraineNow/83900)

A Russian drone struck a multi-story residential building in Khmelnytskyi, wounding seven people, while strikes on Zhytomyr and Khmelnytskyi reportedly hit Nova Poshta logistics facilities. (Source: @eRadarrua/111031)
In Chuhuiv, Kharkiv Oblast, a Russian attack killed nearly an entire family — a 19-year-old woman, 11-year-old boy, and 45-year-old man — with a 40-year-old woman wounded. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)

In Kyiv Oblast's Bucha district, Russian drone attacks on the village of Lisne killed two and injured one, damaging five residential houses and three vehicles across two private house fires. (Source: @UkraineNow/83911)
Russian MoD claims VKS destroyed two Ukrainian UAV control points in Kharkiv Oblast, while Russian forces reported liberating Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR. (Source: @tass_agency/393934)

NATO planners express concern Europe cannot sustain a war with Russia due to rising right-wing party popularity and rapidly declining US support for European contingents. (Source: @tass_agency/393964)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive overnight aerial campaign involving ballistic missiles, KAB guided bombs, and jet-powered Shahed drones across multiple Ukrainian oblasts despite a reportedly agreed three-day ceasefire window for US diplomatic visits. US envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in the Kremlin to discuss a peace plan while planning a Kyiv visit. The Ukrainian General Staff confirmed combat operations continue in full because the ceasefire cannot be unilateral, directly contradicting Moscow's parallel claims that attacks had been reduced.

points: Ukrainian General Staff stated combat operations along the front line continue at full scale despite reports of a three-day 'silence regime,' asserting that a ceasefire cannot be unilateral or asymmetric without endangering military personnel. The statement came after media reports claimed Ukraine and Russia agreed to silence from September 5-8 to secure safe passage for US special envoys to Moscow and Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83900)

A Russian drone struck a multi-story residential building in Khmelnytskyi on September 5, wounding seven people, according to local reporting. Strikes also targeted Zhytomyr and Khmelnytskyi, reportedly hitting Nova Poshta logistics facilities, though official confirmation was still pending. (Source: @eRadarrua/111031)

In Chuhuiv, Kharkiv Oblast, a Russian attack killed nearly an entire family — a 19-year-old woman, an 11-year-old boy, and a 45-year-old man — while a 40-year-old woman was wounded. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)

In the village of Lisne, Bucha district of Kyiv Oblast, Russian drone attacks killed two and injured one person, igniting fires in two private houses and damaging five residential buildings and three vehicles. (Source: @UkraineNow/83911)

According to The War Zone reporting cited by Ukrainian media, Ukrainian F-16 pilots are forced to engage Russian missiles and drones using only onboard cannons because the Air Force must conserve AIM-9 Sidewinder and AIM-120 AMRAAM missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)

Putin met US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in the Kremlin to discuss a peace plan for Ukraine. Witkoff thanked Putin for halting strikes on Kyiv for three days to facilitate the negotiations, and Putin claimed no strikes had hit Kyiv from midnight on the day of talks. (Source: @tass_agency/393961)
Putin claimed the Ukrainian side has significantly reduced the number of attacks, though this was not corroborated with specifics. (Source: @tass_agency/393957)
Russian MoD reported that Russian Aerospace Forces destroyed two Ukrainian UAV control points in Kharkiv Oblast, though no independent confirmation was provided. (Source: @tass_agency/393934)
Putin supported Maria Lvova-Belova's initiative to introduce benefits for large-family purchases of big cars — a domestic policy item. (Source: @tass_agency/393928)

The first serially produced fully import-substituted MS-21 aircraft completed its maiden flight, per Russia's Ministry of Industry and Trade — a domestic industrial development. (Source: @tass_agency/393965)

Russian forces reported the liberation of Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR, with drone operators from the Southern Group of Forces credited for the operation. This was announced alongside the broader offensive context. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)
Russian MoD reported VKS destroyed two Ukrainian UAV control points in Kharkiv Oblast, per TASS/MoD video. (Source: @tass_agency/393934)

A jet-powered UAV was tracked moving from Kharkiv Oblast, passing Berezstyne, on a course toward Poltavshchyna, indicating continued aerial activity tied to the eastern operational zone. (Source: @kpszsu/76643)
A jet Shahed was tracked on a heading to Sakhnovshchyna in Kharkiv Oblast, consistent with sustained aerial pressure along the eastern axis. (Source: @eRadarrua/111030)
Air raid warnings covered Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Kyiv, and Poltava oblasts at the time of reporting, with no hostile UAVs yet detected in these zones. (Source: @eRadarrua/111005)

In Kyiv Oblast's Bucha district, Russian drone attacks on the village of Lisne killed two, injured one, and damaged five residential houses and three vehicles. Separately, a jet-powered UAV was tracked heading toward Bucha and Irpin from the north. (Source: @UkraineNow/83911)

A jet UAV was tracked on Zhytomyr, and another was tracked moving from Kyiv Oblast toward Zhytomyr Oblast's Korosten district, demonstrating layered northern aerial activity. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73772)

A jet Shahed was tracked over the Kyiv/Brovary area with indications it might circle toward Boryspil, and another from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast's Vyshhorod district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73770)
KAB guided bombs targeted southeastern Dnipropetrovsk Oblast and Zaporizhzhia Oblast, marking escalation in guided-munition use along the southern axis. (Source: @kpszsu/76657)
Three UAVs were detected on the right bank of Zaporizhzhia city and its outskirts, with additional jet Shaheds tracked on the city and another inbound from the north. (Source: @eRadarrua/111065)

A group of UAVs was tracked heading toward Odesa Oblast from the Black Sea, with multiple jet Shaheds reported over the Black Sea/Odesa waters and at least one tracked on a heading toward Serhiyivka/Zatoka. (Source: @kpszsu/76671)

A jet UAV was tracked from Zaporizhzhia Oblast toward Solone, and another from the east past Novoivanivka in Zaporizhzhia Oblast — consistent with sustained southern air operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/111063)

Four ballistic missiles targeted Dnipro and additional ballistic missiles targeted Kamyanske, with the threat of further ballistic use flagged from the southeast — a significant escalation in missile strike tempo. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73743)

More than ten jet-powered Shaheds were simultaneously tracked across multiple oblasts including Zaporizhzhia, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Donetsk, Poltava, Cherkasy, Mykolaiv, and Dnipropetrovsk, indicating a saturation-level attack profile. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771)

KAB guided bombs were deployed against Zaporizhzhia Oblast and southeastern Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, signaling expanded use of precision-guided munitions against frontline regions. (Source: @kpszsu/76662)
Hostile tactical aviation activity was detected on the southern axis, triggering warnings of aviation strike use against frontline oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/76651)

key_developments: Four ballistic missiles struck Dnipro with additional ballistic missiles targeting Kamyanske, while the broader overnight salvo included KAB guided bombs on Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts and a saturation array of jet Shaheds across at least ten oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73743)

US envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in the Kremlin to discuss a Ukraine peace plan; Witkoff thanked Putin for halting strikes on Kyiv for three days to facilitate negotiations. (Source: @tass_agency/393961)

Ukrainian General Staff confirmed combat operations continue at full scale, rejecting the three-day 'silence regime' as invalid because a ceasefire cannot be unilateral or asymmetric. (Source: @UkraineNow/83900)

Russian drone struck a multi-story residential building in Khmelnytskyi, wounding seven; separate strikes on Zhytomyr and Khmelnytskyi reportedly hit Nova Poshta logistics facilities. (Source: @eRadarrua/111031)
Russian attack on Chuhuiv, Kharkiv Oblast, killed three family members (ages 19, 11, 45) and wounded a 40-year-old woman. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)
Russian forces reported liberation of Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR, with drone operators from the Southern Group of Forces credited. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)

NATO planners warned Europe cannot sustain a war with Russia due to rising right-wing party popularity and rapidly declining US support for European contingents, per The Guardian. (Source: @tass_agency/393964)
sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo is sharply elevated: Russia executed a multi-domain strike package — ballistic missiles on Dnipro/Kamyanske, KABs on southern oblasts, and a wide saturation salvo of jet-powered Shaheds — even while Witkoff/Kushner negotiations proceeded in the Kremlin. The Ukrainian General Staff's rejection of the unilateral 'silence regime' and Zelensky's reported assurance that Ukraine will not strike Russia during US diplomatic visits suggests a fragile, asymmetric de-escalation in which Russia retains strike freedom. The combination of residential building hits, Nova Poshta logistics targeting, and family casualties in Chuhuiv and Lisne indicates a deliberate pressure campaign against civilian infrastructure and morale, likely timed to coincide with negotiations to demonstrate leverage. The Kurtovka liberation near Druzhkovka, if confirmed, signals continued limited but real tactical ground gains in Donetsk.
sections.regional_response: Diplomatic activity intensified: Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow for Kremlin talks before a planned Kyiv visit announced by Zelensky. European political dynamics appear strained — NATO planners fear Europe cannot sustain a war with Russia due to rising right-wing parties and declining US support for European contingents, per The Guardian reporting. Marine Le Pen's National Rally pledged to 'turn off the tap' on Ukraine financial support if it wins 2027, while Italian General Roberto Vannacci — polling around 7.6% with his Futuro Nazionale party — advocated halting weapons to Kyiv and reviewing NATO membership. Cultural-political isolation of Russian figures continued with the Annapolis Symphony canceling Vadim Repin's collaboration at Ukraine's embassy request.
sections.intelligence_notes: The contradiction between Putin's claim of reduced attacks and the documented overnight saturation salvo across 10+ oblasts is itself an intelligence indicator: Moscow is signaling diplomatic flexibility while sustaining operational pressure. The reported halt on Kyiv strikes from midnight while regional strikes continued suggests strikes on the capital may have been selectively paused as a confidence-building gesture, not a systemic ceasefire. Zelensky's reciprocal commitment not to strike Russia during US visits creates an asymmetric restraint that Russia appears unwilling to mirror. The reported F-16 missile conservation constraint (forcing cannon-only engagements per The War Zone) points to a deepening Ukrainian air-defense munition shortage that directly shapes interception capacity during these mass attacks.
